content.title: USA vs. Japan, 2026 Friendly: Time, TV schedule, streaming and lineups
content.text: The United States Women’s National Team have the finale of their 3-match series with Japan tonight when they meet in suburban Denver to close out the April international window. The USWNT won the first match last Saturday, while Japan got a 1-0 victory on Tuesday in Seattle.The rubber match should be one where both teams throw everything out there to try and get the win, which will hopefully make the game entertaining from an offensive standpoint. Having this third look will allow Emma Hayes to make even more evaluations of her players and which combinations are the best ones.Japan will once again be strong, and they hope to close out the window with a message to the rest of the world that they’re back and should be viewed as a legit contender for the Women’s World Cup. American fans already knew that, and the players did as well. This will make tonight’s match a great one to watch as the two giants have a Mile High battle.Latest Video from SB NationBrandi Chastain: cut from USWNT, bad role model … Icon NEXT About Connatix Visit Advertiser websiteGO TO PAGEYou know that expression "a picture is worth a thousand words"? That started because of Brandi Chastain. Probably. You know the picture I'm talking about. She had just won the '99 World Cup with a penalty kick, and in a moment of unfiltered elation fell to her knees, ripped her shirt off, and screamed with a joy most of us can only hope to one day feel. Today, it's universally regarded as a symbol of women's strength, and fearlessness, and ability. And while some saw it that way at the time... many, very loud people, did not.
